rca_of_the_issue: The minceur.tsx component checks meal.source === 'pro' && meal.assignment_id to determine if a meal is a pro-assigned meal. The backend correctly returns these fields in the API response. However, when the user clicks on the meal card, the navigation goes to /meal-detail?index=0 instead of /meal-detail?mode=assigned&assignmentId=... This suggests the isProMeal variable evaluates to false. Possible causes: 1) Data not yet loaded when component renders, 2) Data transformation stripping these fields, 3) React state not updating correctly. The meal-detail page then falls back to fetching from /api/minceur/weight-details using index, which returns the meal without the proteines_g, glucides_g, lipides_g fields being read correctly.
